search.snippet: Guthix page 3 can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails. The page can then be added to a damaged god book received from the Horror from the Deep quest. There are 4 pages in total. Once all 4 pages are added to the book it becomes a book of balance, which you can then equip in the shield slot, preach from, or use to bless holy or unholy symbols (50 prayer required).

search.snippet: November 8, 2021 - This would only happen through a clearly defined system, and while work continues on the final form, there is a framework where taxes from item sales would work together to help remove excess items from the economy. Finally, there are issues of bank space. If you are a premium player you get 800 bank slots and 400, before any potential bonuses. The proposal is being able to buy bank space directly in blocks of 40 at an ascending rate in gold. So for the first block you might pay a million coins and if you want the ninth block you’ll pay 500 million coins. To read more on the specifics of all of these proposals head to the RuneScape blog.
